groups.defect: Google updateEvent and deleteEvent lose the destination-calendar fallback by searching for an externalCalendarId that is already known to be falsy.
groups.rationale: All report the identical faulty fallback repeated in update and delete, each requiring an edit. Several members explicitly report both occurrences, linking the location-specific reports.

groups.defect: The Google Meet fallback dereferences an undefined first destination calendar when the array is empty or absent.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same unguarded integration access in EventManager and proposes restoring null-safe behavior.

groups.defect: Office365, Lark, and Base calendar implementations are reported as missing the new credentialId parameter and credential-specific destination selection, with Lark also using the first destination in update and delete.
groups.rationale: The broad interface report explicitly includes both unchanged provider signatures and missing per-credential selection, connecting the narrower signature and routing reports. The merged comment must preserve both concerns and the distinct provider and method locations.
